source_manifest.source_name: Mandi, India: Open-Meteo/ECMWF IFS and CAMS global modeled grid
source_manifest.attribution: Open-Meteo; ECMWF IFS; Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) global atmospheric composition forecasts
source_manifest.temporal_resolution: Hourly API positions; CAMS global underlying product is 3-hourly, approximately 45 km
source_manifest.co_location: Different weather/air grids; returned grid coordinates recorded in each receipt; no physical co-location claim
source_manifest.label_provenance: Exact +6h modeled values, no observed hazard labels
source_manifest.original_issue_time_availability: Not verified; retrospective benchmark, not replay of information known at original issue time
